watch.text: William Eklund (ankle) and Warren Foegele (knee) are out and Hayden Hodgson went on IR; Andre Burakovsky travels and may play on the trip.
D Kevin Bahl is out for the season, Martin Pospisil (upper body) did not travel for the road trip, and Jonathan Huberdeau (hip) is on IR.
C Morgan Frost (upper body), hurt in Monday's 2-1 loss at Ottawa, is ruled out at Pittsburgh tonight, per Sportsnet's Eric Francis.
LW Artemi Panarin (personal, missed 4 games) is projected back on the top line and PP1 at Montreal; D Erik Gustafsson is on IR and out.
Montreal acquired C Dylan Larkin from Detroit on 11/22 (for Kirby Dach, G Samuel Montembeault, Hage and picks); he debuted as the 2nd-line center in a 2-1 loss to LA on 11/23.
F Ivan Demidov (ankle) and D Mike Matheson (lower body) were placed on injured reserve on 11/24 and are out vs COL; neither played vs LA on 11/23.
Out: D John Marino (likely the whole road trip), Nick Schmaltz (IR), D Nate Schmidt (week-to-week) and Michael Carcone (3-4 months).
D Dylan DeMelo (lower body) is out 4-6 weeks per the Jets.
Toronto has the most players on IR in the league and has lost 9 of 10; Kirill Marchenko (out since Oct 26) and Colton Sissons skated in non-contact jerseys Sunday; Jack Roslovic is day-to-day.
D Ryan Pulock (shoulder) is out 1-2 weeks, D Alexander Romanov (torn ACL) is out and Kyle Palmieri went on IR on Nov. 24.
Mathew Barzal returned Nov 14 after missing the start of the season.
Mathieu Olivier went on IR on Nov. 24; C Sean Monahan (upper body) is no longer on the injury list.
Out: Anthony Mantha (neck surgery, about a month), D Johnathan Kovacevic (ankle, 4-6 weeks from Nov 17) and D Seamus Casey (knee, LTIR).
No. 1 D Quinn Hughes (upper body, IR) is doubtful Friday vs Colorado per Michael Russo of The Athletic; D Olli Maatta is also on IR.
C Leo Carlsson (upper body, 19.8 TOI) is ruled out again vs SJ on 11/25 and Beckett Sennecke (20.3 TOI) is on IR: two top-six forwards out.
Jared McCann (lower body) is on IR, out about 10 weeks from Oct 25, and Jake O'Brien (lower body) is week-to-week.
D Jacob Trouba (lower body) is out and F Kiefer Sherwood (upper body) went on injured reserve on 11/23; both listed out until at least 12/1.
Zach Hyman (migraine) missed Nov 24 at Vegas and is day-to-day; goalie Frederik Andersen (knee) is on IR, so Devon Levi keeps starting.
Captain Aleksander Barkov (knee, out since Oct. 1) and Brad Marchand (knee) return vs OTT tonight, the Panthers said Wednesday morning; our ratings are built without them.
C James Hagens (back) is on injured reserve, in a non-contact sweater at Tuesday's practice.
D Mattias Samuelsson is a game-time decision vs the Rangers and C Tyson Kozak is day-to-day; Konsta Helenius, Justin Danforth and Matt Grzelcyk are on IR.
LW Nikolaj Ehlers is listed out and D K'Andre Miller is day-to-day; Brandon Bussi is the likely starter in goal at Tampa.
C Matt Duchene is on IR about three months after core surgery; D Lian Bichsel and D Kyle Capobianco are also on IR since Nov 14.
G Sam Montembeault (lower body) is on IR and D William Wallinder is day-to-day.
Bjorkstrand and D Alberts Smits out to late Jan, Veleno (Nov 20) and Dorofeyev (Nov 24) on IR; Shesterkin out for the season.
Egor Chinakhov is listed out tonight; Bryan Rust (lower body) and Nick Robertson are on IR. Evgeni Malkin is no longer on the injury list.
Connor McMichael and D Brandon Carlo are on IR (Nov 24); Pavel Buchnevich and Jimmy Snuggerud missed Nov 25 at the Islanders and are day-to-day.
Brandon Hagel (lower body) is on IR since Nov 15 and Conor Geekie had shoulder surgery (4-5 months).
C Elias Pettersson (upper body) is ruled out for the rest of the road trip, including tonight at DET, and is expected out until at least early December.
Jordan Kyrou is listed out and D Vincent Desharnais (appendectomy) will miss tonight vs Philadelphia; D Rasmus Sandin is cleared for contact.
C Nathan MacKinnon (lower body) is expected to miss about 12 weeks after seeing a specialist.
D Cale Makar (lower body) returned Nov 25 in a 6-0 win over Montreal after missing three games; our ratings carry the games he missed.

401892775.summary: Ottawa is missing three forwards (Eklund, Foegele, Burakovsky), which covers some of the gap; Linus Ullmark (.937, 11-1-0) was first off at the morning skate and starts.

reasons.text: Senators forwards William Eklund, Warren Foegele and Andre Burakovsky are out.
Linus Ullmark was first off the ice at Monday's morning skate and is starting against Calgary.

401892779.summary: The Wild are without No. 1 D Quinn Hughes (now on injured reserve) and start Filip Gustavsson in his season debut, which our ratings don't see; that covers part of the gap between our 67% and the market's 62% on Minnesota.

reasons.text: Quinn Hughes (upper body, hurt at Calgary) was placed on injured reserve on 11/23 and misses tonight at SJ; ESPN lists 11/27 as his earliest return.
Confirmed starters: Filip Gustavsson makes his season debut for Minnesota (Joe Smith); Yaroslav Askarov starts for San Jose (Max Miller).
Moneyline opened at about Wild -1.0 goals and has drifted toward the Sharks, consistent with the Hughes news.

401892780.summary: Zach Hyman is ruled out tonight and Devon Levi is confirmed in Edmonton's net (Carter Hart likely for Vegas), which covers part of the gap; the rest is our rating split, not news.

reasons.text: Hyman (migraine) won't play vs Vegas, per Oilers play-by-play announcer Jack Michaels; Nugent-Hopkins was expected back after missing four games.
Devon Levi is confirmed to start for Edmonton; Carter Hart is the likely Vegas starter.

401892791.summary: Quinn Hughes (IR) is still out for Minnesota, which accounts for part of the gap, but Utah is short Schmaltz, Marino and Schmidt too, so the market's 59% looks cautious.

reasons.text: No. 1 D Quinn Hughes went on IR Nov. 23 and is expected to miss Wednesday vs. Utah; John Hynes hopes for more on him Wednesday (Friedman: not believed serious).
Utah has Nick Schmaltz, John Marino and Nate Schmidt on IR and Michael Carcone out, which cuts against the market's lean.

401892784.summary: Florida's captain Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand, out nearly all season, return tonight vs Ottawa (team announcement Wednesday morning); our ratings are built without them, which explains the market's lean to Florida.

reasons.text: The Panthers said Wednesday morning that Barkov and Marchand are returning from knee injuries vs Ottawa.
Paul Maurice called Barkov's return Wednesday vs. Ottawa realistic and Marchand possible; Florida put Cole Reinhardt on waivers to make room. Both have knee injuries from early October.
Ottawa is still without forwards William Eklund, Warren Foegele and Andre Burakovsky (IR) and Hayden Hodgson.

401892782.summary: The Rangers have lost four forwards and a defenseman to injury since Nov 20, which our ratings barely see; that covers part of the gap to the Sabres' -135 price.

reasons.text: Rangers out: Bjorkstrand and D Alberts Smits (IR Nov 21, to late Jan), Joe Veleno (IR Nov 20) and Pavel Dorofeyev (IR Nov 24); only one game since, a 5-2 home loss to Carolina Nov 22.
Shesterkin is out for the season (knee); Joonas Korpisalo is confirmed in the Rangers' net tonight and Luukkonen is the likely starter for Buffalo.
Buffalo returns home after a five-game trip (2-3, wins at WSH and TB) and lists D Mattias Samuelsson and C Tyson Kozak day-to-day.

401892793.summary: Anaheim is without two top-six forwards (Carlsson, Sennecke), which our ratings don't see; San Jose's own absences offset some of that.

reasons.text: Leo Carlsson (upper body) is ruled out vs San Jose; coach Joel Quenneville doesn't expect a long absence.
Beckett Sennecke, Ryan Poehling and A.J. Greer are on IR for Anaheim; San Jose is without D Jacob Trouba and F Kiefer Sherwood (IR).
Confirmed starters: Alex Nedeljkovic (.902) for San Jose instead of Askarov, Laurent Brossoit (.867) for Anaheim instead of Dostal (.857).

401892798.summary: St. Louis is short four regulars (McMichael and Carlo on IR, Buchnevich and Snuggerud day-to-day), which covers part of why the market makes Dallas the favorite.

reasons.text: Connor McMichael and D Brandon Carlo went on IR Nov 24; Pavel Buchnevich and Jimmy Snuggerud missed Wednesday's 3-2 loss at the Islanders and are day-to-day.
Dallas is without C Matt Duchene (core surgery, about three months), D Lian Bichsel and D Kyle Capobianco, all on IR; our ratings already carry most of those games.

401892803.summary: Minnesota will likely be without No. 1 D Quinn Hughes and Colorado has Cale Makar back, both pushing the market's way, but MacKinnon's long absence cuts the other way.

reasons.text: Quinn Hughes (upper body, IR since Nov 23) is doubtful for Friday vs Colorado, expected to join the road trip that starts Sunday in Chicago, per Michael Russo of The Athletic.
D Cale Makar returned from a three-game absence in Wednesday's 6-0 win over Montreal; our ratings still carry the games he missed.
C Nathan MacKinnon is out about 12 weeks (lower body), which our ratings only partly reflect, so that leans toward our Wild number.

returning.text: Back from a three-game absence on Nov 25 vs Montreal.

swings.COL: Cale Makar returned Nov 25 (6-0 win over Montreal) after missing three games; the market prices him back, our ratings still carry his absence, and Minnesota's Quinn Hughes is doubtful.

swings.EDM: Nothing firm found: Zach Hyman (missed the Nov 24 loss at Vegas) is day-to-day and may return at home, and Seattle is without Jared McCann and Jake O'Brien, so the market leans further to Edmonton.
